---
name: havenline-environment-review
description: Compare actual Havenline screenshots and motion against the two user-supplied videos; keep reference fidelity, code checks and device-performance evidence distinct.
---
Read AGENTS.md, Docs/Design/ReferenceVideoLock/REFERENCE_VIDEO_LOCK.md, its reference-video-sources.json and Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/ACCEPTANCE.md before review.

The videos ending 124839 and 124510 are authoritative, not loose inspiration. Obtain and open their actual pixels or the checksum-tracked extracted frames. tools/havenline/extract_reference_frames.py reconstructs the selected samples from verified original uploads. Reading filenames or the builder's summary does not establish reference inspection. Missing source pixels means reference fidelity UNREVIEWED and blocks approval.

Compare source-bound candidate gameplay screenshots AND motion against corresponding reference timestamps/states. Cover all twelve comparison scenarios in the source manifest: both fishing/production/service and harvesting/hunting/supply/defense loops. Missing gameplay states are INCOMPLETE, not silently excluded from scoring. Review relevant front/rear/sides/three-quarter, closeups, complete motion/transfer cycles, camera transitions and additional night/weather views.

Match the reference's bright sculpted winter style, dense blue-white forest framing, warm cleared work zones, machinery, tall inventory/cash stacks, crowd/service density, helpers and marked upgrade pads. More realism, bark noise or polygons is not proof of fidelity. The former requirement to show both cabin assets in the normal frame is superseded as a composition target. Preserve assets without forcing the wrong scene layout.

Provide visual scores only for actual inspected evidence. Every mandatory dimension/state must reach exactly 10/10 and every check must pass. No averaging, rounding, unchanged rescoring, omitted unreviewed areas or fabricated independent execution. Preserve raw findings, model/source/frame hashes, timestamps and actual capture names. Invalid or unsupported model observations require checking against pixels/motion. Code checks, geometry counts, export success and builder self-review are not independent visual approval.

Automatic phone AND tablet layout, touch, saves and lifecycle must be validated on representative devices. Sustained native >=3840x2160 at scale 1.0 and >=60 FPS requires named physical phone and tablet evidence with full-load presented-frame timing, resolution and thermals for at least 30 minutes each. Screenshots, emulators, fixed-step capture, software benchmarks or engine counters are not certification.

Kaleb must not be asked to test unfinished APKs. Keep playable handoff blocked until full functionality, actual-reference fidelity, independent 10/10 review, no-placeholder art and both device categories pass. Internal development exports may continue. Missing evidence is a blocker, not a user-testing assignment. This skill is a definition, not proof that a critic has executed.

Do not modify production assets or lower requirements while critiquing. Keep custom Characters 2–4 rigging fixes and final reviews last; preserve their original files and the approved animal roster.
